equations.description: Blockage factor of a discontinuous two-row pintle: n orifices per row of widths w_1 (first row) and w_2 (second row) over the pintle perimeter pi*D_p. Both rows' widths are summed, so a two-row BF is not the same quantity as a single-row BF = N*w/(pi*D).

variables.meaning: number of orifices in each row (22 in this study)

assumptions: same orifice count n in both rows

claims.statement: In a previous combustion test of a pintle injector with BF = 86% (referring to Ryu's case [17]), pintle damage occurred because of excessive heat transfer to the pintle tip [20].
